body_markdown:
[All Announcements](https://feedback.heypocket.com/announcements) 8 Apr, 2026


Maclean here from Pocket, here's this weeks highlights:


**✨ New**


- Folders!
- Refreshed web & desktop design
- New meeting overlay on MacOS


**🚀 Improvements**


- Better speaker recognition in summaries
- Daily highlights/Insights are more value-heavy and less noisy
- More human sounding emails & drafts
- Better transcription accuracy on Pocket Pro
- Better calendar auto-linking
- More actions in search menu on web & desktop


**👀 Coming soon**


- Sync to Notion & Obsidian
